objective: A new Critical finding and a regression each notify, and neither message carries evidence
preconditions: a webhook integration on this project
input: A scan reporting a new Critical, then a scan reproducing a resolved finding
expected: Two deliveries — securityCriticalFinding and securityRegression — naming the category and endpoint and carrying no payload, no request and no response value. A notification goes to a channel whose membership nobody audits
detail: 2 delivery(ies): SecurityCriticalFinding, SecurityRegression; no evidence in any body
